candidateAudit.title: Die berühmte Original Böhmische Fischsuppe Manche Gerichte sind mehr als nur eine Speise, sie erzählen Geschichten von Familie, Tradition und einem besonderen Geschmack, den man ei
candidateAudit.text: Die berühmte Original Böhmische Fischsuppe Manche Gerichte sind mehr als nur eine Speise, sie erzählen Geschichten von Familie, Tradition und einem besonderen Geschmack, den man ein Leben lang nicht vergisst. Im Oktober hat bei uns wieder ein besonderes Familienrezept seinen großen Auftritt: die Original Böhmische Fischsuppe. Seit vielen Jahren gehört sie im Schweizerhaus zur herbstlichen Schmankerlkarte und das aus gutem Grund. Ursprünglich wurde diese traditionelle Fischsuppe, deren Hauptdarsteller der Karpfen ist, von Oma Kolarik zu Weihnachten für die Familie zubereitet. Heute holen wir die Lieblingssuppe unseres Chefs bereits im Herbst aus dem Familienrezeptbuch und servieren sie im Oktober auf unserer wöchentlichen Schmankerlkarte. Für ihren unverwechselbaren Geschmack und ihre feine, sämige Konsistenz sorgen unter anderem Karpfenmilch und Karpfenrogen. Sie verleihen der Suppe ihre natürliche Bindung und machen sie zu einem besonderen Genuss. Der feine Fischgeschmack kommt dabei ganz ohne künstliche Geschmacksverstärker aus. Zum Schluss geben ein Schuss Rotwein und etwas Zitronensaft der Suppe den perfekten Feinschliff. Wer die hausgemachte Original Böhmische Fischsuppe nach dem traditionellen Familienrezept kennenlernen möchte, sollte uns im Oktober unbedingt noch besuchen. Ob im herbstlich goldenen Gastgarten oder, wenn es draußen etwas kühler wird, in unseren gemütlichen Innenbereichen. Wir freuen uns darauf, Ihnen ein Stück unserer Familiengeschichte servieren zu dürfen.

candidateAudit.title: Today is Coming Out Day. We celebrate everyone who has come out, whether once or a hundred times. We also make room for everyone who can't, won't, or isn't ready yet. For many tran
candidateAudit.text: Today is Coming Out Day. We celebrate everyone who has come out, whether once or a hundred times. We also make room for everyone who can't, won't, or isn't ready yet. For many trans people, BIPOC queers, and folks without secure papers or family support, being visible can cost a lot. Nobody owes the world a coming out. That's why spaces like Villa Vida matter. Since 2019 we've been a living room for Vienna's queer community, a place where you don't have to explain yourself. Out, not out, still figuring it out: you belong here. Heute ist Coming Out Day. Wir feiern alle, die sich geoutet haben, ob einmal oder hundertmal. Und wir halten Platz für alle, die es nicht können, nicht wollen oder noch nicht so weit sind. Für viele trans Personen, BIPOC-Queers und Menschen ohne sicheren Aufenthalt oder Rückhalt in der Familie kann Sichtbarkeit viel kosten. Niemand schuldet der Welt ein Coming-out. Genau deshalb braucht es Orte wie die Villa Vida. Seit 2019 sind wir ein Wohnzimmer für die queere Community in Wien, ein Ort, an dem du dich nicht erklären musst. Out, nicht out oder noch am Herausfinden: Du gehörst dazu. 📍 Linke Wienzeile 102, Wien · Main entrance / Haupteingang: Spörlingasse 1 villavidacafe #VillaVida #ComingOutDay #QueerWien #QueerVienna #LGBTQIA

candidateAudit.title: this is our yasai ramen. and your sunday evening reminder that you can enjoy this stunner tomorrow from 11:30. our newest vegan addition starts with a dashi made from celery, a bro
candidateAudit.text: this is our yasai ramen. and your sunday evening reminder that you can enjoy this stunner tomorrow from 11:30. our newest vegan addition starts with a dashi made from celery, a broth that takes its time and rewards you for paying attention, building layer after layer of savoury flavour without ever feeling heavy. wild broccoli brings a little texture, mizuna keeps things fresh, tofu adds substance, and plenty of negi makes sure every spoonful tastes just right. it’s completely vegan, although most people stop talking about that part after the first few bites. this is the bowl for anyone who thinks a ramen needs meat to be satisfying, for anyone who orders vegetables reluctantly, and for everyone who simply wants a bowl that feels comforting without putting you straight to sleep afterwards. deeply savoury, full of umami and surprisingly rich for something built entirely from plants, it’s proof that a great ramen doesn’t need much more than a very good broth and the right ingredients around it.

candidateAudit.title: INSIDERSTOFF 🔥 „Wein ist ein Jahrhunderte altes Kulturgut, das wie kein anderes versucht, Handwerk und Herkunft zu vereinen und schmeckbar zu machen. Mit dem Chardonnay Ried Freud
candidateAudit.text: INSIDERSTOFF 🔥 „Wein ist ein Jahrhunderte altes Kulturgut, das wie kein anderes versucht, Handwerk und Herkunft zu vereinen und schmeckbar zu machen. Mit dem Chardonnay Ried Freudshofer 2023 ist der Familie Nittnaus genau das gelungen“, ist unser Category Manager Simon überzeugt. Gewachsen auf sehr kalkhaltigem Boden und geprägt von guter Sonnenexposition, ist dieser Chardonnay die perfekte Umsetzung von Weinguts-Philosophie und der Joiser Top-Lage 🍇 Die Nase ist zu Beginn zurückhaltend mit leichter Reduktion, aber dahinter tauchen schnell gelbe Früchte in Richtung Apfel und Quitte und dezente Holznoten auf, unterstützt von fermentierter Zitruswürze 🍋 Mit Spannung, Druck und einer ordentlichen Portion Würze geht es dann direkt auch am Gaumen weiter ⚡️ Man fühlt Dichte und Konzentration, aber gleichzeitig bleibt der Wein elegant und leichtfüßig. „Weine wie der Chardonnay Ried Freudshofer begegnen ihren Burgunder-Kollegen definitiv auf Augenhöhe!“ 💪 📸 (c) Unleashed Studio #weinundco #weinliebe

candidateAudit.text: Every great house remembers the people who passed through it. ✨ For Anna Sacher, hospitality was always personal. She began the tradition of collecting her guests’ signatures on embroidered tablecloths and portraits, which still fill the famous picture gallery today. It is where culture came to life: from the beginnings of Romy Schneider’s journey, to Queen Elizabeth dining in the Restaurant Rote Bar, to John Lennon and Yoko Ono bringing their bagism performance to Hotel Sacher. Every signature is a story, and the story is still being written. Episode 5 of A Sacher Story is now live. candidateAudit.text: ‼️Salzburg Havalimanı 100 sezonluk çalışan arıyor Salzburg Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart Havalimanı, yaklaşan kış sezonu için farklı alanlarda çalıştırılmak üzere yaklaşık 100 ek personel arıyor. İşe alınacak çalışanların kasım ayının ortasından mart ayının sonuna kadar süreli olarak görev yapması planlanıyor. Personel ihtiyacının özellikle yoğun kış turizmi nedeniyle arttığı belirtiliyor. Havalimanında açık pozisyonlar arasında uçak yer hizmetleri, bagaj ayrıştırma, yolcu hizmetleri, apron çalışmaları, temizlik, yolculara yönelik sağlık hizmetleri ve teknik görevler bulunuyor. Yoğun günlerde 26 bin yolcu Salzburg Havalimanı kış sezonunda özellikle kayak turizmi nedeniyle oldukça yoğun çalışıyor. En yoğun günlerde havalimanında 170 uçak iniş ve kalkış yaparken, yolcu sayısı 26 bine kadar çıkabiliyor. Yolcuların önemli bölümü İngiltere, İrlanda, İsrail ve Almanya’dan geliyor. Almanya’daki havalimanları üzerinden de farklı ülkelerden Salzburg’a turistler ulaşıyor. Geçtiğimiz kış sezonunda Salzburg Havalimanı personel ihtiyacının bir bölümünü Almanya’dan karşılamıştı. Nürnberg Havalimanı’ndan yaklaşık 20 sezonluk çalışan, özellikle check-in ve yolcu hizmetlerinde Salzburg’daki ekiplere destek vermişti.

candidateAudit.title: Avusturya’da evini yenileyene devlet desteği: 5.000 Euro’ya kadar teşvik Avusturya hükümeti, konutların yenilenmesi ve eski ısıtma sistemlerinin değiştirilmesi için 500 milyon Euro
candidateAudit.text: Avusturya’da evini yenileyene devlet desteği: 5.000 Euro’ya kadar teşvik Avusturya hükümeti, konutların yenilenmesi ve eski ısıtma sistemlerinin değiştirilmesi için 500 milyon Euro’luk yeni bir teşvik programı açıkladı. Yeni desteklerden bazıları Kasım 2026’da, kapsamlı termal yenileme destekleri ise Ocak 2027’de başlayacak. Program kapsamında evini enerji açısından daha verimli hale getirenler, pencerelerini değiştirenler veya eski petrol ve gazlı ısıtma sistemlerini yenileyenler devletten maddi destek alabilecek. Yeni pencerelere 4.000 Euro’ya kadar 2027’den itibaren eski pencerelerini enerji tasarruflu modellerle değiştiren ev sahipleri, yenileme kapsamında 4.000 Euro’ya kadar destek alabilecek. Aynı zamanda dış cephe güneş koruması, örneğin panjur veya dış jaluzi yaptırılması halinde 1.000 Euro daha verilebilecek. Böylece toplam federal destek 5.000 Euro’ya kadar çıkabilecek. Ancak devlet, teşvik kapsamına giren yatırım maliyetinin en fazla yüzde 30’unu karşılayacak. candidateAudit.text: Avusturya’da son seçim anketi: FPÖ yüzde 40’a ulaştı, üç hükümet partisini geride bıraktı Avusturya’da 11 Ekim 2026 tarihinde yayımlanan iki yeni seçim anketi, siyasi partiler arasındaki dengelere ilişkin dikkat çekici sonuçlar ortaya koydu. Herbert Kickl liderliğindeki FPÖ, anketlerde ilk sıradaki yerini korurken, araştırmalardan birinde yüzde 40’a ulaşarak üç hükümet partisinin toplam oy oranını geride bıraktı. FPÖ yüzde 40, hükümet ortakları toplam yüzde 39 Kronen Zeitung için IFDD araştırma şirketinin gerçekleştirdiği ankette partilerin oy oranları şöyle ölçüldü: FPÖ: Yüzde 40 ÖVP: Yüzde 19 Yeşiller: Yüzde 14 SPÖ: Yüzde 13 NEOS: Yüzde 7 KPÖ: Yüzde 5 Bu sonuçlara göre Başbakan Christian Stocker liderliğindeki ÖVP, SPÖ ve NEOS koalisyonunun toplam oy oranı yüzde 39'da kalıyor. Ankette dikkat çeken bir başka gelişme ise Yeşillerin yüzde 14 ile SPÖ'nün önüne geçmesi oldu. KPÖ'nün yüzde 5'e ulaşması da partinin seçim barajını aşabileceğine işaret ediyor. İkinci ankette FPÖ yüzde 37 Heute gazetesi için Unique Research tarafından yapılan diğer araştırmada ise FPÖ'nün oy oranı yüzde 37 olarak ölçüldü. Bu ankette ÖVP yüzde 20, SPÖ yüzde 17, Yeşiller yüzde 12 ve NEOS yüzde 9 seviyesinde bulunuyor. Böylece iki araştırma da FPÖ'nün ilk sırada olduğunu gösterirken, özellikle SPÖ'nün oy oranlarında araştırmalar arasında farklılıklar dikkat çekiyor. SPÖ'deki yönetim değişikliği gündemde SPÖ'de son günlerde yaşanan yönetim tartışmaları ve parti içindeki yeniden yapılanma süreci, Avusturya siyasetinin önemli gündem maddelerinden biri olmaya devam ediyor. candidateAudit.text: Viyana’da öğretmen açığı hafifledi ancak sorun bitmedi: Çok sayıda öğretmen yarı zamanlı çalışıyor Viyana’daki zorunlu eğitim okullarında yıllardır gündemde olan öğretmen sıkıntısında bu eğitim yılında bir miktar rahatlama yaşandı. Ancak sendika temsilcilerine göre personel sorunu tamamen çözülmüş değil. Özellikle çok sayıda öğretmenin yarı zamanlı çalışması okullardaki en önemli sorunlardan biri olmaya devam ediyor. Viyana Eğitim Müdürlüğü’nün verilerine göre kentte şu anda yaklaşık 18 bin öğretmen görev yapıyor. Öğretmen sendikası temsilcileri, bu yıl eğitim döneminin önceki yıllara kıyasla daha rahat başladığını belirtiyor. Ancak öğretmenlerin önemli bir bölümünün henüz üniversite eğitimine devam ettiği ve bu nedenle yalnızca yarı zamanlı çalışabildiği ifade ediliyor. Sendika temsilcisi Karin Medits-Steiner, öğretmenlik eğitimi devam ederken okullarda görev yapan çok sayıda kişinin bulunduğunu ve bunların önemli bölümünün part-time çalıştığını belirtti. Öğretmen sayısı tek başına yeterli değil Sendikanın diğer kanadından Thomas Krebs ise yalnızca toplam öğretmen sayısına bakmanın yeterli olmadığını savunuyor. Krebs’e göre öğretmenlerin hangi görevleri üstlenebildiği ve ne ölçüde kullanılabildiği de dikkate alınmalı. Özellikle üniversite eğitiminin yanında öğretmenlik yapan kişilerin, tam zamanlı bir öğretmenin üstlendiği tüm okul sorumluluklarını yerine getirmesi mümkün olmayabiliyor. 440 başvurudan 60 kişi işe alındı Öğretmen ihtiyacını karşılamak amacıyla meslek dışından öğretmenliğe geçiş programından da yararlanılıyor. Avrupa başta olmak üzere dünyanın farklı ülkelerinde yaşayan ve başarılarıyla Türkiye’yi gururlandıran vatandaşlara selamlarını ileten Erdoğan, 7 milyonu aşkın Türk diasporasının önemine dikkat çekti. Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, konuşmasında şu ifadeleri kullandı: “Yurt dışında yaşayan siz kardeşlerimizi ne dışarıdaki yabancı düşmanı akımların ne de vatandaşlarımıza -affedersiniz- ‘zırzop’ diyerek aşağılayan ahlak yoksunu tiplerin insafına asla bırakmayacağız.” Erdoğan, yurt dışındaki Türklerin kimliklerini ve kültürlerini koruyarak yaşadıkları toplumlara katkı sağlamalarının önemini vurguladı. Kültürel ırkçılık, İslam düşmanlığı ve yabancı karşıtlığıyla mücadeleye de değinen Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, bu alanlarda faaliyet gösteren Uluslararası Demokratlar Birliği’nin çalışmalarını takdir etti. Türkiye’nin yurt dışındaki vatandaşlarına yönelik desteğinin devam edeceğini belirten Erdoğan, ilgili kurum ve kuruluşlar aracılığıyla vatandaşların yanında olmayı sürdüreceklerini ifade etti. Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, mesajını UID’nin 9. Olağan Genel Kurulu’nun başarılı geçmesi temennisiyle tamamladı.

candidateAudit.title: Heute ist internationaler Mädchen*Tag und wir stellen euch Olivia vor. Olivia ist seit Jahren in der Jugendarbeit tätig und leitet auch den Arbeitskreis queerfeministische Mädchen*
candidateAudit.text: Heute ist internationaler Mädchen*Tag und wir stellen euch Olivia vor. Olivia ist seit Jahren in der Jugendarbeit tätig und leitet auch den Arbeitskreis queerfeministische Mädchen*Arbeit in den Wiener Jugendzentren. ♀️Der heutige Aktionstag macht weltweit auf die Herausforderungen aufmerksam, mit denen Mädchen* tagtäglich konfrontiert sind und stellt zugleich klar: Mädchen* haben Rechte, auf Mitbestimmung, Sichtbarkeit und Empowerment. 👏Olivia sagt dazu: "In meiner Arbeit ist mir wichtig, Mädchen* und Frauen* zu begleiten und sie mit unterschiedlichen Methoden, auf ihrem Weg zur Selbstermächtigung zu unterstützen. Ihren Stimmen soll Raum gegeben werden, um sich Gehör zu verschaffen und selbstbestimmt für eigene Bedürfnisse eintreten zu können. Gesellschaftliche Erwartungen an Mädchen* und Frauen* sind oft tief verwurzelt, spiegeln dabei aber häufig nicht die Vielfalt der eigenen Persönlichkeit wider. Die eigene Identität zu finden und damit gesellschaftlich zugeschriebene Stereotype zu hinterfragen ist ein Prozess, den ich als Jugendarbeiterin gerne fördern möchte. Dies kann sowohl in genderhomogenen Settings, wie Mädchen*tagen oder Mädchen*räumen, als auch in der Arbeit mit Vorbildern abseits abseits tradierter Genderrealitäten ermöglicht werden." Mehr über unsere speziellen Angebote für Mädchen* findet ihr auf unserer Website. Link in Bio 🔗 #maedchen #mädchen #girlsDay #WienerJugendzentren #jugendarbeit

candidateAudit.text: Viyana’da öğrenciler başörtüsü yasağına karşı sokağa çıktı Viyana’da yüzlerce öğrenci, okullarda 14 yaşına kadar kız öğrencileri kapsayan başörtüsü yasağını protesto etmek için cuma günü sokağa çıktı. Gösterilerde yasağın kaldırılması talep edilirken, eğitim sistemine daha fazla bütçe ayrılması çağrısı da yapıldı. Protestolar; Sosyalist Gençlik, AKS, Rote Falken, bazı komünist gençlik örgütleri ve “Schule brennt” girişiminin katılımıyla düzenlendi. Viyana’daki “okul grevine” yüzlerce öğrenci katılırken, başka eyaletlerde de protesto çağrıları yapıldı. Gösterilerde başörtüsü yasağının yanı sıra eğitim bütçesi ve öğrencilerin kendi yaşamlarıyla ilgili kararlara katılımı gibi konular gündeme getirildi. Viyana’da 53 bildirim Yeni düzenlemeye göre okul alanında başörtüsü yasağına uymayan öğrenciler önce öğretmenleri tarafından uyarılıyor. İhlalin devam etmesi halinde aileyle okul yönetiminde görüşme gerçekleştiriliyor. Sonraki aşamada konu Eğitim Müdürlüğü’ne taşınabiliyor ve devam eden ihlaller para cezasıyla sonuçlanabiliyor. 8 Ekim itibarıyla Viyana’da Eğitim Müdürlüğü düzeyinde 210 görüşme gerçekleştirildi. Devam eden ihlaller nedeniyle 53 vakada idari makamlara bildirim yapıldı. Uygulanabilecek para cezalarının 150 ile 800 Euro arasında olduğu belirtiliyor ve tekrarlanan ihlallerde yeniden ceza uygulanması mümkün. candidateAudit.title: Avusturya’da elektrikli otomobiller atağa geçti: Benzinli ve dizelleri geride bıraktı Avusturya’da otomobil pazarındaki dönüşüm hızlandı. Statistik Austria’nın eylül ayı verilerine
candidateAudit.text: Avusturya’da elektrikli otomobiller atağa geçti: Benzinli ve dizelleri geride bıraktı Avusturya’da otomobil pazarındaki dönüşüm hızlandı. Statistik Austria’nın eylül ayı verilerine göre, tam elektrikli otomobillerin yeni kayıt sayısı benzinli ve dizel otomobillerin toplamını geçti. Eylül ayında Avusturya genelinde 28.968 yeni otomobil trafiğe kaydedildi. Bu rakam geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 12,5 artış anlamına geliyor. Elektrikli otomobillerde yüzde 80,6 artış Ay içerisinde 9.723 tamamen elektrikli otomobil yeni kayıt yaptırdı. Elektrikli araçlardaki artış geçen yılın aynı ayına göre yüzde 80,6 oldu. Buna karşılık 6.727 benzinli ve 1.833 dizel otomobil kaydedildi. Böylece klasik benzinli ve dizel araçların toplamı 8.560 seviyesinde kaldı. Benzinli otomobillerin yeni kayıtları yüzde 12,1, dizellerinki ise yüzde 28,2 geriledi. Hibritler hâlâ güçlü Benzin-hibrit otomobillerde eylül ayında 9.917 yeni kayıt yapıldı ve yıllık bazda yüzde 11,2 artış görüldü. Dizel-hibritlerde ise tablo tersine döndü. 718 yeni araçla bu kategoride kayıtlar yüzde 38,2 azaldı. Alternatif motor sistemine sahip otomobillerin toplam yeni kayıt sayısı 20.358’e ulaşırken, yıllık artış yüzde 31,6 olarak kaydedildi. Motosiklet satışlarında da yükseliş Eylül ayında tüm motorlu taşıtlarda toplam 37.510 yeni kayıt gerçekleştirildi. Bu rakam geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 9,5 daha yüksek. Motosikletlerde de artış yaşandı. L3e sınıfında 2.723 yeni kayıtla yüzde 15,2, 50 cc mopedlerin yer aldığı L1e sınıfında ise 972 kayıtla yüzde 24,8 artış kaydedildi.

candidateAudit.title: Thanks for joining the opening of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ this week! At AIL researchers and artists show the
candidateAudit.text: Thanks for joining the opening of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ this week! At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphor. — on till 5 Nov 2026 Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 The exhibition emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) Next guided tours: 15 Oct, 16:00–18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 21 Oct, 16:00—18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 5 Nov 12:00—13:00 Guided Tour 13:15—15:30 Workshop with Franziska Allerberger Out of Balance: On the Quest for Reconnecting (Register via this link) Photos: Hannah Mayr _hannahmayr_ The project 03: Soil is generously supported by ÖAW. oeaw.at

candidateAudit.title: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive na
candidateAudit.text: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive narrative obscures a deeper, more ‘errant’ truth? Media theorist and author Clemens Apprich in conversation with philosopher Jan Völker. Moderated by Amanda Holmes, Department of Philosophy, University of Applied Arts Vienna Welcome: Ulrike Kuch, Rector of the University of Applied Arts Vienna A cooperation of the department of Media Theory and the department of Philosophy. ‘Errant Intelligence’ challenges the prevailing biological and individualistic interpretations of machine learning, arguing instead for a radical understanding of machine intelligence. The book embraces the deviations, inconsistencies, and ‘errant behaviour’ as fundamental to the discovery of new knowledge, moving beyond the illusion of mere optimisation. Drawing on media theory, cybernetics, and a unique psychoanalytic lens, it explores the ‘technological unconscious’ of machine learning. It traces the historical roots of AI, from early automatons and the Turing machine to natural language processing and contemporary machine learning systems. Challenging the idea of an autonomous, self-generating AI, the book exposes the hidden labour, assumed logics, and inherent biases that animate its operation. It re-evaluates computational thinking, insisting on its inherently social, collective, and symbolic character, and revealing how language and logical paradoxes are not obstacles but constitutive forces that shape intelligent machines

candidateAudit.title: In this workshop with Helena Detsch we will explore simple ways to create a fascinating natural color palette from soil and plant-based materials like earths, minerals, vegetables,
candidateAudit.text: In this workshop with Helena Detsch we will explore simple ways to create a fascinating natural color palette from soil and plant-based materials like earths, minerals, vegetables, kitchen supplies and algae pigments. Part of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ Duration: 15:30–17:30 Please register for this workshop via link in bio (free entry) Together, we'll first experiment with making self-made oil- or watercolors from 100% natural sources and then explore the many possibilities of sustainable painting, discovering how these self-made colors behave on paper and fabric and what a truly organic painting practice can look like. In her oil paintings, installations and animations, Helena Detsch explores (mis-)relationships between humans and more-than-human life. Her series and immersive spatial installations question Western anthropocentric narratives about nature as a resource and create spaces to reflect on coexistence and complex interconnections between human and other agents. To develop a more sustainable art practice, she crafts natural colors from plant and soil pigments. helena.kettu AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna dieangewandte

candidateAudit.title: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and sever
candidateAudit.text: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. What is happening beneath our feet? At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). Join the extended exhibition program: 6 Oct Exhibition Opening with Performances by Michael Bahn, Johanna Unterpertinger and Christian Prohammer 8 Oct 15:30–17:30 Workshop with Helena Detsch The Organic Painter – Painting

candidateAudit.text: We keep on digging and the next artistic research exhibition will open in October – Save the date and join us! Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) Opening Program, 6 Oct 18:00 Welcome by Julienne Lorz expanded_museum_studies (Expanded Museum Studies, AIL Executive Board) and introduction by Soil team members 19:00 Soil rememb

candidateAudit.title: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Appli
candidateAudit.text: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Applied Photography and Time-Based Media at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, which explores the synergistic potential of student teams from different degree programs. In collaboration with the department Industrial Design, this year’s focus was on the intersection of photography and the object, with particular attention paid to the relationship with set design, styling, casting and narrative. Seen from the perspective of Applied Photography, the object and thus the chair, is a welcome protagonist. Photography’s multiple applied genres are cited here: documentary, fashion, advertising, architecture and the portrait. When the function in Industrial Design coalesces with the idea of the purpose in Applied Photography, the question of factuality emerges. Be not mistaken: The most literal things are often the most confusing and enigmatic. Between what it is and how it is*, worlds unfold. We put the images to work. VDW Cocktail: 29 Sep, 17:00–18:00 Showcase and drinks followed by a collective walk to the billboards in front of the main entrance of the University Open Saturdays: 26 Sep / 3 Oct, 11:00–18:00 Opening hours: Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna The collaborative works are on display at the AIL and on the billboards at the university’s main entrance on Oskar-Kokoschka-Platz. dieangewandte viennadesignweek applied.photography angewandte_id Feat

candidateAudit.text: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ €20 per person · cash at the door 💛 Soli tickets available 📝 Registration required 🌈 Who is it for? Queer people who want to meet other queer people — whether you’re looking for dating, friendship, flirting, new connections, or simply meeting more of the community. You’ll meet multiple people through a series of short mini-dates. Privately note who you’d like to connect with again — romantically, platonically, or otherwise. Please note that simultaneous conversations can mean significant background noise. 📝 Register via the link in bio/event page. Come as you are and see who you click with. 💘

candidateAudit.text: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is delighted to once again host one event in the program. unsafeandsounds AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna (Free entry) Overview: 18:30 Panel Discussion, unsafe+sounds in cooperation with the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures (University of Applied Arts Vienna) weibel.institute Affective Histories Timotheus Vermeulen and Christian Höller in conversation with Sophie Publig History is never simply given. It is made through the scales and materials by which the past becomes legible: from sweeping narratives and historical events to gestures, sounds, images, technical infrastructures, and seemingly minor traces SOPHIE PUBLIG is a Senior Scientist researching digital ecosystems. Based at the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, she navigates the intricate networks of online territories. TIMOTHEUS VERMEULEN is Professor of Media, Culture and Society at the University of Oslo and joint director of the Media Aesthetics Research Group. He was a visiting scholar in Art History at Harvard in 2023–24 and will serve as joint Principal Investigator on a project on the politics of tone at the Centre for Advanced Study in Oslo in 2027–28. CHRISTIAN HÖLLER is editor and co-publisher of springerin – Hefte für Gegenwartskunst. Since 2024 he is head of the department Cross Disciplinary Strategies at the University of Applied Arts Vienna. cro

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed way to spend your Saturday evening? Join us for (board) Gayme Night at Villa Vida Café, an evening of games, queer community, and meeting people. 📅 Saturday, 5 September ⏰ 18:00–late 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna Whether you’re a board game enthusiast, an occasional player, or have absolutely no idea what you’re doing, you’re welcome. 🃏♟️🎲 Come by yourself, with a friend, with a partner, or with a whole group. Arriving alone is completely normal—you can join a table and meet people through playing rather than having to make endless small talk. 🌈 What to expect: ✨ Board and card games ✨ Beginner-friendly atmosphere ✨ Queer community & new faces ✨ No need to be competitive ✨ Stay for one game or the whole evening ✨ Bring a favourite game if you want — or simply show up 🌍 Languages: We’re a multilingual community. English and German are commonly spoken, but there’s no required event language. Tables can play in whatever language works for everyone involved. ♿ Accessibility: Villa Vida Café has step-free access and an accessible toilet. The café is non-smoking indoors. Please keep in mind that several games and conversations may happen at once, so the space can become lively and noisy.

candidateAudit.text: It was a good run❤️ Just a little first batch of photos we’re ready to share today- more memories from our anniversary are coming. ✨August 26, we celebrated our 5th anniversary. Five years full of stories, crazy moments, challenges, lessons, and beautiful memories. Thank you to everyone who has been with us, is with us now, and keeps coming back. candidateAudit.title: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developi
candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.text: 🎬 Sapphic Film Series: Rebel Dykes Punk meets feminism at the next edition of our Sapphic Film Series at Villa Vida Café. 🖤 Join us for a free screening of Rebel Dykes, a documentary exploring the lives of a group of lesbians who helped shape a radical queer subculture in 1980s London. Through stories of friendship, sex, activism, nightlife, art and resistance, Rebel Dykes takes us into a world where punk collided with feminism and queer people created their own spaces, communities and ways of living. Rather than presenting queer history as something distant or polished, the documentary is told through the people who were there — the rebels who lived, loved, organised, partied and challenged expectations both inside and outside feminist movements. Everyone who wants to engage respectfully with sapphic and queer cinema. The series centres sapphic stories and experiences, but you do not need to identify as sapphic or queer to attend. Friends and allies are welcome too. ♿ Accessibility Villa Vida Café has a ramp at the Linke Wienzeile entrance and an accessible toilet on the ground floor. candidateAudit.title: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to conne
candidateAudit.text: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to connect with an audience. Join drag artist DaDa JV for an interactive workshop exploring the art of storytelling through drag and performance. Together, you’ll look at how movement, music, character, costume, emotion, and stage presence work together to create performances that leave a lasting impact. This workshop is open to performers of all experience levels, from those taking their first steps into drag to seasoned artists looking to deepen their creative practice. Participants are encouraged to bring ideas, works in progress, or simply their curiosity. Together we’ll explore: • Finding your unique performance voice • Building a story through movement and music • Connecting authentically with an audience • Using drag as a tool for self expression and community • Developing confidence on stage Expect a welcoming, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged and every participant’s perspective is valued. Event Details Saturday, August 29 4:00 PM Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna This workshop is donation based. Give what you can. No one will be turned away for lack of funds. Come ready to learn, share, and discover new ways to bring your story to life on stage.

candidateAudit.text: Versprechen gehalten! 🤌🍕 Noch im Winter stand über uns im Falstaff: „Im Jänner eröffnet Mio #2 in Wien Mitte und erweitert sein Erfolgsrezept.“ (siehe 2. Slide). Wir hatten große Ziele und wollten beweisen, dass wir unsere kompromisslose Qualität und die Seele Neapels genau so an unseren neuen Standort bringen können. Heute, nur wenige Monate nach der Eröffnung, halten wir das Ergebnis im Falstaff Streetfood Guide 2026 in den Händen: Ebenfalls 94 Punkte für Mio am Stadtpark!😍 Dass wir aus dem Stand heraus direkt in der Spitzenliga mitspielen und 58/60 Punkte fürs Essen abräumen, macht uns unfassbar stolz - und auch ein bisschen sprachlos. Che traguardo incredibile! 🇮🇹 Danke an falstaff.magazin für diese Auszeichnung. Und ein ganz besonderes, emotionales Grazie di cuore an unser Team am Stadtpark, das dieses Level jeden einzelnen Tag abliefert, sowie an euch, unsere Gäste, die uns vom ersten Tag an hier so grandios empfangen haben. Die Reise geht jetzt erst richtig los.💛 Verratet uns: Welche unserer Pizzen am Stadtpark hat bei euch die 100 Punkte verdient? candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed evening of games and great company? Join Gayme Night Vienna at Villa Vida Café for a free community board game night where everyone is welcome. candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. candidateAudit.title: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alt
candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. A project by by Zora Hünermann and Jakob Margit With contributions by: Ulrike Fritzsche, Koschka Cosmo Keye, Juarez Suarez, Ghanishka Kedar, Sei Jeung, Ghazal Naeimi, Dongjoo Kim, Jazzmin, Margherita Pruneti, Nicolás Henao Bonnet, Roma Bogdanov, and Grisha Terno.

candidateAudit.text: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A performance and poem by Carla Schwering and Timna Lugstein from by the department of Institute of Fine Arts & Media Art – Photography (Sophie Thun) The phrase "Schreiben wir uns zusammen" that on the surface means something like “let’s write to each other again in more detail” actually implies a postponement. In the performance, the artists type excerpts from their shared chat history in a poetic arrangement on two typewriters facing each other – messages in which they attempt to get closer to one another. The time and effort spent cancelling meet ups, for which there is supposedly no capacity is made visible. With the postcards created for the performance, visitors can reconnect with a long-lost friend. On the occasion of Angewandte Festival AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. We will give you an overview, step by step AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leonard.ottb The audio performance Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) explores how sound can model processes of memory formation and transformation. Layered oscillations and brief sound textures repeat with phase shifts, gradually overlapping and partially canceling each other out, much like the traces in an overwritten manuscript. The work is inspired by memory research on reconsolidation – in which recalling an event alters its stored form – and its cultural studies counterpart, reconstructivity. The piece is composed of multiple layers of sound that continuously overlap anew, attempting to cancel each other out in the process. In this process, however, the layers are never completely erased, so that fragments of the preceding states always remain Leonard Otterbein is a sound artist and composer with a background in ecology and ecotoxicology, where he studied mixture effects of agricultural pesticides and nanoparticles. His work spans instrumental and electroacoustic composition, examining perceptual thresholds. He works with psychoacoustic effects and approaches sound as spatial and sculptural material shaped by its relation to space. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.text: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsparkasse as part of Angewandte Festival! 'LIMINAL TRACES. Celebrating Acoustic Ecologies' is a dynamic sound lecture that understands the acoustic world as a phenomenon of resonance, shaped by connectedness and interaction. Through the live-curated interplay of field recordings, physical and digital artefacts, the performance traces sonic imprints deeply embedded in our collective memory, presenting them as a new listening experience. Developed within SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS at the AIL, this solar performance explores the intersections of sound, pop history and solar energy, celebrating concept, improvisation and the (unexpected) emergent. The performance ends when the energy collected by the mobile solar unit runs out. — The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who conceived and initiated SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS, is working since 2023 at AIL with international artists and systems scientists to form experiential spaces by artistic means (scenographies) and to create sensory impressions that help us to better understand and resonate with living systems. During the project essential principles of living systems are transformed into olfactory, auditory and tactile artworks / artefacts and used experimentally. Team: Jeanette Müller, Paul Divjak, Alexandra Graupner, Anna-Maria Irgang

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 July 2026, 15:00 Hypervigilant Performance by Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz iukumukui Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory artscience.ak Constant vigilance can develop as a response to racial discrimination and transgenerational trauma, allowing potential threats to be recognized in advance. This fight-or-flight state activates the nervous system and can lead to chronic muscle tension and bruxism. Teeth grinding occurs as a way of coping with stress during sleep, often driven by societal expectations to suppress fear or anger. Hypervigilant addresses this suppressed anger. Aluminum teeth suspended from the ceiling form a space similar to a cage that oscillates between protection and exposure. Shaped as gong-like instruments, the oversized representation of the artist’s bite is set into vibration during a sound performance to release embodied pressure and reduce tension in the nervous system. Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz’s practice centers on suppressed experiences expressed in imagined worlds. Through performative sculptures and installations, she examines spatial dynamics and power structures. Addressing socio-political themes such as racism, sexism, gender, and sexuality, she builds subconscious environments using reference-based objects and constructions in combination with text and sound. candidateAudit.text: As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Performance by Laura Oyuela and Ádám Salomvári (students of the department Cross-Disciplinary Strategies) Rocks, I mean; - Stars is a sonic and spatial performance departing from text, soundscapes, spoken words and its physical surrounding. The piece works with analogies between black holes and human beings through low frequencies, orbital motion, and stretched time, shaping a field that gathers bodies into one another. The project investigates how perceptual, cognitive, and affective dynamics shape the experience of artistic performance in relation to contemporary conditions of subjectivity, particularly isolation and hyperproductivity. The performance is part of the Cross-Disciplinary Strategies Master’s program exhibition 2026. The work is realised with the technical support of ÆSR Lab, which has contributed to its sonic and spatial development. Photo: earthboundeva

candidateAudit.text: SAUERTEIG – FÜR UNS KEIN TREND. SONDERN STANDARD. 🍞 In letzter Zeit liest man überall „mit Sauerteig“, „Sauerteigbrot“, „lange Teigführung“ – fast so, als wäre es die neueste Erfindung. Für uns ist Sauerteig aber nichts Neues. Wir sind auf keinen Trend aufgesprungen. Wir backen seit Anbeginn mit Sauerteig. Und zwar ALLE unsere Brote. Warum? Weil wir keinen Sinn darin sehen, ein Brot ohne Sauerteig zu backen. Egal ob: 🥖 hell oder dunkel 🌾 mit Gewürzen oder pur ☁️ ultra luftig oder besonders saftig 🍞 klassisch oder rustikal Bei uns ist jedes Brot ein Sauerteigbrot. Das heißt für euch: Wenn ihr Sauerteigbrot mögt, müsst ihr euch bei uns nicht fragen „Welches Brot ist mit Sauerteig?“ Die Antwort ist einfach: Alle. Immer. candidateAudit.text: Kurti. Es gibt Menschen, die betreten einen Raum… und plötzlich wird alles ein bisschen heller, ein bisschen lauter und ein bisschen lebendiger. Du warst genau so ein Mensch. Für uns warst du Freund, Zuhörer, Familienmitglied, Vertrauter und Wegbegleiter. Du hattest für jeden ein offenes Ohr, für jeden einen ehrlichen Rat und hast ein gemeinsames Bier nie abgeschlagen. Du hast dir nie ein Blatt vor den Mund genommen, hast gelacht, diskutiert, gefeiert und das Leben mit einer Intensität gelebt, die einfach nur ansteckend war. Deine Familie war immer dein Ein und Alles. Und irgendwie hast du es geschafft, dass sich auch viele von uns wie ein Teil deiner Familie fühlen durften. Du warst bunt, laut, schrill, herzlich, manchmal unbequem, immer ehrlich… und genau deshalb unvergesslich. Die Welt verliert mit dir einen echten Charakter. Einen Menschen, der lieber gemeinsam gelacht als gejammert hat. Einen Menschen, der lieber gefeiert als Trübsal geblasen hat. Und vielleicht beschreibt kein Satz dich besser als jener, den du selbst immer gelebt hast: „Die Welt hört auf lässig zu sein, wenn man sich selbst zu ernst nimmt.“ Nicht jeder Abschlag muss perfekt sein. Nicht jeder Ball landet dort, wo man ihn haben wollte. Aber du hast uns gezeigt, dass man trotzdem weiterspielen, darüber lachen und danach gemeinsam ein Bier trinken kann. Heute stehen wir hier mit schweren Herzen. Aber wir wissen auch, dass du wahrscheinlich der Erste wärst, der uns sagt, wir sollen nicht so ein Theater machen, uns zusammensetzen und auf die guten Zeiten anstoßen. Also genau das machen wir. candidateAudit.title: Nach unfassbaren 25, unheimlich schönen, sehr lehrreichen, extrem intensiven, manchmal furchtbar mühsamen, sehr feierlichen, fröhlichen, schrägen, überraschenden, ja oft auch feuch
candidateAudit.text: Nach unfassbaren 25, unheimlich schönen, sehr lehrreichen, extrem intensiven, manchmal furchtbar mühsamen, sehr feierlichen, fröhlichen, schrägen, überraschenden, ja oft auch feuchtfröhlichen, leider manchmal auch sehr traurigen, aber immer sehr menschlichen, stets emotionalen und letztendlich wunderbaren Jahren U.S.W., verlasse ich mein geliebtes Beisl nach einem 1/4 Jahrhundert. Nie hätte ich gedacht so lange dabeizusein und ich weiß nicht, ob ich es - mit heutigem Wissen - nochmal machen würde. Aber eines weiß ich: ich bin unendlich dankbar für die vielen Menschen, die ich hier kennenlernen durfte, für die vielen wertschätzenden, respektvollen, so tollen, lieben Gäste, die zu Freunden wurden und die mir so ans Herz gewachsen sind. Extrem dankbar bin ich meinen Wegbegleitern, von denen ich speziell Kerstin, Eva und Elisabeth DANKE sagen möchte, nicht zuletzt auch Reini..RIP. Danke, dass es euch gibt, danke, dass ihr mir auch zur Seite gestanden seid, wenns mal schwer war, auch mit mir persönlich. Danke an die extrem treuen Stammgäste. Ihr seid alle der Wahnsinn! ❤️❤️❤️❤️ Das U.S.W. wird weitergehen. Ich werde mich neuen Projekten widmen, davor mal alles verarbeiten und mal mein Telefon nachts abschalten. Kommt alle am 30.5. vorbei. Ich freu mich auf jeden von euch! Und alle die es nicht schaffen: Am 27.5. findet das letzte Quiz unter meiner "Regie" statt. Es wird mein etwa 1250. sein. 😱 Wer auch das nicht schafft, schaffts davor, dazwischen oder danach. Allen anderen: Danke, es war mir eine Ehre. Macht's gut! ❤️

Thanks to Casa Decor, bynost, and takepointrealestate for helping bring it all together.

candidateAudit.title: Man sagt immer, zehn Jahre seien eine lange Zeit – aber wenn man etwas mit Leidenschaft macht, vergeht eine Dekade schneller, als man denkt. Ein Lokal ist mehr als Wände, Tische un
candidateAudit.text: Man sagt immer, zehn Jahre seien eine lange Zeit – aber wenn man etwas mit Leidenschaft macht, vergeht eine Dekade schneller, als man denkt. Ein Lokal ist mehr als Wände, Tische und Stühle. Ein Lokal lebt von denen, die darin arbeiten – und von denen, die es füllen. Und deshalb möchten wir heute vor allem eines tun: Danke sagen. Danke an all unsere Mitarbeiter, die uns auf diesem Weg begleitet haben – ob für ein paar Monate oder über viele Jahre. Jede einzelne Person hat ein Stück Geschichte geschrieben. Ohne euch gäbe es dieses Lokal nicht. Ohne euren Einsatz, eure langen Nächte und euren Humor wären wir nicht zehn Jahre alt geworden. Und natürlich: Danke an euch, unsere Gäste. Ihr wart in schwierigen Zeiten loyal, ihr seid in guten Zeiten fröhlich, und ihr seid immer wieder hier, weil ihr das QERO zu einem besonderen Ort macht. Viele von euch sind zu Freunden geworden, manche fast zu Familie. Zehn Jahre QERO – das ist nicht nur ein Jubiläum. Das ist ein Beweis dafür, dass ein Traum, der mit Herz beginnt, Wirklichkeit werden kann. In diesem Sinne: Auf die letzten zehn Jahre – voller Höhen, Emotionen und Erinnerungen. Und auf die nächsten zehn Jahre – die hoffentlich noch schöner, noch erfolgreicher und noch peruanischer werden. Muchas gracias Salud! #qeroviena

candidateAudit.title: Liebe Petra! Mein liebes Schatzi! Alles erdenkliche liebe und gute zu unseren 11 Hochzeitstag! Wir sind in einem halben Jahr 14 Jahre zusammen, seit 11 Jahren glücklich verheiratet
candidateAudit.text: Liebe Petra! Mein liebes Schatzi! Alles erdenkliche liebe und gute zu unseren 11 Hochzeitstag! Wir sind in einem halben Jahr 14 Jahre zusammen, seit 11 Jahren glücklich verheiratet und 9 Jahre ist es her seit Matheo‘s Geburt! Ich hab keinen einzigen Tag davon bereut, Dich und die Kinder in mein Leben gelassen zu haben. Ihr habt meinen Lebensaltag derart bereichert das ich meinen Lebensinn in euch gefunden hab! Da kann man beruflich noch so erfolgreich sein, ohne euch wär alles nichts. Du unterstützt mich in jeder Lebenslage, hältst mir meinen Rücken frei wenn es mir wieder mal zu viel wird und,und,und… Alles aufzuzählen würde hier den Rahmen sprengen. Einfach gesagt du bist die besserer Hälfte die mir in meinen Leben gefehlt hat und mit der ich den Rest meines Lebens verbringen möchte. In ewiger liebe, dein Schatz René

candidateAudit.text: Als Würstelstandler in der Inneren Stadt weiß ich, wie wichtig eine gute Stadtpolitik ist. Täglich erlebe ich, wie Maßnahmen wie Fußgängerzonen und mehr Grünflächen unser Grätzel lebenswerter machen – für alle, die hier leben, arbeiten oder einfach gern ein Würstel in der Sonne genießen. Mit meinem Verein habe ich es geschafft, dass die Wiener Würstelstand-Kultur zum UNESCO-Immateriellen Kulturerbe zählt – weil diese Kultur ein Stück Wiener Identität ist. Jetzt kandidiere ich für die SPÖ bei der Bezirksvertretungswahl in der Inneren Stadt. Gemeinsam mit Lucia Grabetz kämpfe ich für eine Innenstadt, die sozial, lebendig und für alle da ist – nicht nur für Tourist:innen. Für mehr Aufenthaltsräume, starke Nahversorgung und den Schutz echter Wiener Tradition. #scharferRené #SPÖInnereStadt #WienerWürstelstand #UNESCOKulturerbe #Bezirksvertretungswahl #LebendigeInnenstadt #TeamLucia

candidateAudit.title: WKO Wien Wahl 2025 – Eine starke Stimme für die Gastronomie! Liebe Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmer, bei der WKO Wien Wahl 2025 trete ich für den Sozialdemokratischen Wirtschaftsve
candidateAudit.text: WKO Wien Wahl 2025 – Eine starke Stimme für die Gastronomie! Liebe Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmer, bei der WKO Wien Wahl 2025 trete ich für den Sozialdemokratischen Wirtschaftsverband Wien (SWV) in der Fachgruppe Gastronomie auf Platz 13 an. Ich bin keiner, der nur redet – ich bin ein Macher. Seit über 20 Jahren setze ich in meinen eigenen Unternehmen vieles um, und genau mit dieser Energie werde ich mich als Ausschussmitglied der Fachgruppe Gastronomie für die Interessen der Würstelstände und Gastronomen einsetzen! Mein Ziel ist klar: Bessere Rahmenbedingungen, faire Unterstützung und eine starke Stimme für unsere Branche!
